# Separate console web tests from Thunderbird UI tests

The recorded console workflow specifies launchReviewBrowser from commands/graph/ai-browser.mjs for local web UI tests. The request describes it as headless Chromium with a fresh session and no Phabricator authentication. Thunderbird UI checks require a matching Thunderbird build and its headless test harness because Chromium cannot validate Thunderbird chrome. These are stated workflow requirements and capability claims; this evidence does not show a browser launch or completed runtime check.

Scope: TB Tools browser validation.
